name: persistent risk retries once and cooldown blocks more refreshes
invalid fingerprint keeps original identity and login
unrelated endpoints and non-risk errors do not rotate
manual reset preserves account, persists and rate limits
logout during refresh prevents late mutation or retry
valid stream with voucher does not trigger refresh
late Set-Cookie cannot restore replaced identity
startup reuses repaired identity instead of fetching again
cooldown write failure performs no fingerprint request
POST and other hosts never auto-rotate
